name: SwitchBord MCP
description: Reviews SwitchBord's hosted MCP lookups for paid agent APIs (x402, MPP). SwitchBord only reads unpaid 402 price replies and never holds or moves funds. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Keep find_paid_endpoint on Review so the user sees each lookup before an agent goes shopping for paid APIs.
SwitchBord only reads unpaid 402 price replies; any payment is made by the agent directly to the seller, never through SwitchBord.
